Replicate Visuals

A model-routing scaffold for freezing generated image outputs from Replicate into project assets.

Installable integration scaffold

This manifest can be installed, locked, and evaluated today. Execution remains blocked until its reviewed adapter ships, so a scaffold never silently runs incomplete code.

Capabilities

image

Install

npx lazy plugin install replicate-visuals -p <project>
